psychIntro: Short, well-established questionnaires show how you have been over the weeks. The result is not a diagnosis – talk to your doctor about it.
psychSettingsSubtitle: Mood, anxiety and journal – with PHQ-9 and GAD-7 as a monthly questionnaire.
psychQuestionnairesSubtitle: Reminder 30 days after the last one; trend on the “Mental health” page.
psychQuestion: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by any of the following problems?
psychPhq1: Little interest or pleasure in doing things
psychPhq3: Trouble falling or staying asleep, or sleeping too much
psychPhq4: Feeling tired or having little energy
psychPhq6: Feeling bad about yourself — or that you are a failure or have let yourself or your family down
psychPhq7: Trouble concentrating on things, such as reading the newspaper or watching television
psychPhq8: Moving or speaking so slowly that other people could have noticed? Or the opposite — being so fidgety or restless that you have been moving around a lot more than usual
psychPhq9: Thoughts that you would be better off dead or of hurting yourself in some way
psychGad1: Feeling nervous, anxious or on edge
psychGad2: Not being able to stop or control worrying
psychGad3: Worrying too much about different things
psychGad5: Being so restless that it is hard to sit still
psychGad7: Feeling afraid as if something awful might happen
psychBands: PHQ-9: 0–4 minimal · 5–9 mild · 10–14 moderate · 15–19 moderately severe · 20–27 severe. GAD-7: 0–4 minimal · 5–9 mild · 10–14 moderate · 15–21 severe.
psychSource: PHQ-9 (Kroenke et al. 2001) and GAD-7 (Spitzer et al. 2006). Free to use; not a substitute for a medical diagnosis.
psychSupportTitle: You don’t have to carry this alone
psychSupportText: If you are thinking about hurting yourself, please talk to someone. These services are there for you around the clock:
psychSupportGeneric: Please contact a crisis line in your country or your local emergency services. Doctors and people you trust can help, too.
psychSupportPrivacy: This note only appears on your device. Nothing is sent.
psychTopicDescription: Check-ins for mental health symptoms and monthly questionnaires
psychReminderBody: A month has passed – two minutes for PHQ-9 and GAD-7?
